environment.description: Same Kubernetes CI runner pod in ci-runners namespace with identical application code. Pod annotation specifies a custom OCI runtime hook that loads a node-local seccomp profile from /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/ci-runner-hardened.json. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO defaultAction with an explicit allowlist of 87 syscalls required for Python interpreter operation (read, write, open, close, stat, fstat, mmap, mprotect, brk, rt_sigaction, access, getpid, clone3 for threading, futex, etc.) but notably EXCLUDES execve, execveat, ptrace, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, sendto, recvfrom, and all other network/process-spawn syscalls. The fork/clone syscalls are permitted ONLY with CLONE_THREAD|CLONE_VM flags via SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ argument filtering. Profile was generated via strace profiling of the Python interpreter running pure-Python test assertions without subprocess invocation.
